names.es: Huevo Cocido al Vapor (fácil de pelar)

metadata.notes: The real, cited steamed-egg technique (see data/actions/steam.json's citationNote and REFERENCES.md) — 720 seconds (12 minutes) in a basket above boiling water, then an ice-bath shock, then peel. The direct sibling of soft-boiled-egg.json, swapping BOIL for STEAM specifically to demonstrate the real, practical reason STEAM exists for egg at all: easier peeling (egg.json's own steamNote), not a different eaten result the way potato.json's steaming is (a real, measured compositional difference — see that file's own steamNote). statePrerequisites.peel/shock ('boiled' widened to ['boiled','steamed']) is what makes this sequence legal at all — without that widening, a steamed egg would have been a dead end unable to ever reach PEEL, defeating the entire point of the technique.
